defs.def: to take willingly sth that is offered; to say ‘yes’ to an offer, invitation, etc. 收受；接受（建议、邀请等）

ex.s: Grateful and relieved, Emily accepted the offer.
ex.t: 满怀感激和如释重负的埃米莉接受了这个提议。

ex.s: I’ve come to accept that whatever ____55____ I set for myself, they just have to be my own.
ex.t: 我已开始接受：无论我给自己设定什么____55____，它们必须是我自己的。

ex.s: 13. _________ focusing on winning the approval of others, try to understand and accept yourself.
ex.t: 13. ____专注于赢得他人认可，试着理解并接受自己。

ex.s: This time around, I can accept my limitations but keep going.
ex.t: 这一次，我能接受自己的局限，但继续前行。

ex.s: So, if we accept that the universe is unknowable, we also accept we will never know if we live in a computer simulation.
ex.t: 所以，如果我们接受宇宙是不可知的，我们也接受我们永远无法知道是否生活在一个计算机模拟中。

ex.s: But all of that growth will take up a lot of space, and though more and more people accept the concept of solar energy, few like large solar panels to be installed near them.
ex.t: 但所有这些增长都会占用大量空间，而且尽管越来越多的人接受太阳能的概念，却很少有人喜欢附近安装大型太阳能板。

ex.s: It is encouraging to discover that by readily accepting our errors and wisely placing ourselves in the way of being wrong, we can in fact overcome weaknesses and rise stronger.
ex.t: 令人鼓舞的是，我们发现，通过欣然接受错误、明智地让自己处于可能犯错的位置，我们事实上能克服弱点、变得更强。

ex.s: It helped that in the end I was accepted into one of the other programmes I was also excited about.
ex.t: 好在最后我被另一个我也同样期待的项目录取了。

ex.s: Short writings missed as a result of an excused absence will be accepted.
ex.t: 因准予缺勤而错过的短写作业将被接受。

ex.s: Just accept your differences and learn to work with each other.
ex.t: 接受你们的差异，学会彼此合作。

ex.s: The couple has a high   51   rate in getting accepted as house sitters and they always go beyond the homeowner's   52  .
ex.t: 这对夫妇作为看房者被接受的（第51空）率很高，而且他们总是超出房主的（第52空）。

ex.s: My colleague ____54___ to accept it, saying that we were all just ___55___ our job.
ex.t: 我的同事____54____接受它，说我们都只是在____55____自己的工作。

ex.s: It was not widely accepted as a travel concept 64 the late 1980s.
ex.t: 直到20世纪80年代末，它才作为一种旅行概念被广泛接受。

ex.s: People are willing to accept foreign cultures.
ex.t: 人们愿意接受外国文化。

ex.s: “But we all have to accept that as we get older our reactions slow down and this often results in people avoiding any potentially challenging driving conditions and losing confidence in their driving skills.
ex.t: “但我们都必须接受，随着年龄增长，我们的反应会变慢，这通常导致人们避开任何可能有挑战的驾驶状况，并对自己的驾驶技术失去信心。”

ex.s: Remember to arrive on time if you accept the invitation.
ex.t: 如果你接受邀请，记得准时到达。

ex.s: Learning to learn When you are extending or accepting an invitation, pay special attention to the following information:the date and time, what to bring, where to meet, etc.
ex.t: 学会学习：当你发出或接受邀请时，要特别注意以下信息：日期和时间、带什么、在哪里碰面等。

ex.s: Accept the invitation, but ask for the following information: what the festival is called when the festival takes place what it celebrates what the customs are what you need to bring Yes, I'd love to… When does…?
ex.t: 接受邀请，但要询问以下信息：节日叫什么、何时举行、庆祝什么、有什么习俗、需要带什么。是的，我很乐意……什么时候……？

ex.s: Most people with good sense would accept that we can and should learn from accidental failures.
ex.t: 大多数有常识的人都会接受，我们能够也应该从意外的失败中学习。

ex.s: However, some high sugar brands, like Classic Coca Cola, have accepted the sugar tax and are refusing to change for fear of upsetting consumers.
ex.t: 然而，一些高糖品牌，如经典可口可乐，已接受糖税，并拒绝改变，以免惹恼消费者。

ex.s: On Malaita, the most- populated island that’s part of the Solomon Islands, shells are accepted at most places in “How much tuna you can get for your shells depends on their color and shape,” Mary Bruno, a shop owner from the small town of Auki, on Malaita, told Vice.
ex.t: 在所罗门群岛人口最多的马莱塔岛，大多数地方都接受贝壳。“能用贝壳换到多少金枪鱼取决于它们的颜色和形状，”马莱塔小镇奥基的店主玛丽·布鲁诺告诉Vice。

ex.s: Accepting sadness as part of life helps Riley deal with the emotional complexity of growing up, and settle down in her new life.
ex.t: 接受悲伤作为生活的一部分，帮助莱莉应对成长中的情感复杂性，并在新生活中安定下来。

ex.s: Try making an effort to understand others and accept that not everyone has the same sense of humour or fun.
ex.t: 试着努力理解他人，并接受不是每个人都有同样的幽默感或乐趣。

defs.def: to receive sth as suitable or good enough （认为合适或足够好而）接受
to agree to or approve of sth 同意；认可
to admit that you are responsible or to blame for sth 承认，承担（责任等）
to believe that sth is true 相信（某事属实）
to continue in a difficult situation without complaining, because you realize that you cannot change it 容忍，忍受（困境等）
to make sb feel welcome and part of a group 欢迎；接纳

ex.s: The Saint Lukas train doesn’t accept passengers — it accepts only the sick.
ex.t: 圣卢卡斯号列车不接纳乘客——它只接纳病人。

ex.s: Accept the uncomfortable
ex.t: 接纳不适

ex.s: We all want it to accept and love ourselves.
ex.t: 我们都希望它接纳并爱我们自己。

ex.s: Moreover, the USA has a track record of successfully accepting immigrants.
ex.t: 此外，美国有成功接纳移民的记录。

ex.s: It was so good to feel accepted for what I'm good at.
ex.t: 因为我的长处被接纳，这种感觉真好。

defs.def: to allow sb to join an organization, attend an institution, use a service, etc. 接纳，接受（为成员、会员等）
